evidence: MgF2 thin films were deposited in an Oxford OpAL showerhead-style ALD reactor using alternating exposures of Mg(CpEt)2 and anhydrous HF at substrates temperatures from 100 to 250 /C14 C. A saturating dose of Mg(CpEt)2 was delivered with a bubble-through exposure of 1 s, shorter exposure times were observed to result in a reduction in film thickness at the edges of the 200 mm substrate table. A saturating HF dose was delivered via vapor draw at the minimum system pulse time of 15 ms. A purge of 10 s was used for subsequent depositions described in this work.
